profile.name: Henry Zhang
profile.eyebrow: Software engineer · AI systems · New York
profile.headline: I build useful software at the intersection of AI, data, and product.
profile.bio: Hello, I'm Henry. I'm a Computer Science and Business graduate from NYU Shanghai with a passion for engineering, analytics, and making things happen. I am looking for a role where I can apply my experience developing and optimizing AI-driven applications, embedding models, data pipelines, and full-stack products.
profile.personalNote: I enjoy driving cool solutions and experimenting with web development and AI. I've lived in Virginia, New York, and Shanghai, enjoy learning about new cultures, and am fluent in Chinese.
profile.welcome: Welcome to my site. Explore my work, experience, and the tools I use to build.
profile.availability: Open to new-grad software engineering roles

projects.title: Fine Tuning for Financial Sentiment
projects.description: Fine-tuned LLaMA for financial sentiment analysis and incorporated the results into an LSTM to improve stock price movement predictions.
projects.impact: Built an end-to-end research pipeline covering data preparation, model adaptation, feature generation, and downstream evaluation.

projects.title: Resume Portfolio
projects.description: This website, coded from scratch so you can learn about me, my experience, and the projects I have built.
projects.impact: Rebuilt the original MERN-era portfolio as a routed React application with reusable content components and an authenticated editing workflow.

projects.title: Natural Language to Database Communication
projects.description: Using LangChain agents, created a chatbot component that enables natural-language database communication and generates reports from relational data.
projects.impact: Designed the schema-aware prompt flow, report experience, and interface states that made generated queries easier to understand and validate.

projects.title: Airline Flight Booking Simulator
projects.description: Created a relational database for flight information and enabled authentication for customers, airline staff, and agents to view, change, and purchase flights.
projects.impact: Modeled shared booking data and permissions around practical CRUD flows, relational constraints, and role-specific access.

experience.description: Supported project planning, reporting, and delivery coordination across client-facing technical work, translating progress and risks into clear operating updates.
Implemented and improved a retrieval-augmented generation application over more than 20,000 medical records.
Developed an AI application that facilitated employee-to-database communication and generated reports for non-technical users.
Guided project groups using Agile development and shared practical experience with web development, AI, and the tools needed to complete their projects.
Led the inaugural Technical Consulting chapter at NYU Shanghai, including member education, project-team management, and correspondence with TAMID Global.
Implemented a schema to extract, transform, and load user analytics from MongoDB into BigQuery.
